GTA VI is More Than Just a Violent Crime Thriller. It's an Unexpected Exercise in Love and Empathy

Grand Theft Auto VI is inescapable; everyone is talking about it. Even people and venues you wouldn’t expect are taking notice. I certainly didn’t have The Weather Channel and Anderson Cooper on my bingo card. Workers are taking time off to play and teachers have alternately canceled classes and bribed their students not to play hooky.
